premises.text: Livestock disease creates huge economic and public-health risk, yet outbreaks are caught too late despite large annual spend on drugs and treatments
premises.evidence_span: we're not catching these events until it's far too late

premises.text: REX combines historic/real-time clinical data with animal and pathogen genomics into one standardized view of animal health and disease
premises.evidence_span: we bring in historic and real-time data, and then we combine it into one standard format, and finally combine this clinical information with genomics data

premises.text: Software pillars help vets diagnose at point of care and spot outbreaks, mine records for effective treatments including farm-level antibiotic resistance maps, and help pharma find gene targets/pathogens faster
premises.evidence_span: we have three pillars to our software

premises.text: Annual subscription to livestock and pharma customers, with add-ons for collaborative custom projects, leveraging customer-vendor network effects
premises.evidence_span: we charge them an annual subscription fee to access our tools and data

value.text: Predict, prevent, and precisely manage animal disease for a safer and more sustainable food supply
value.evidence_span: predict, prevent, and precisely manage disease in animals to ensure a safer and more sustainable food supply

secondary_value.text: Faster drug/vaccine development by predicting causal genes and pathways

causal_links.evidence_span: $13 billion in losses can be prevented if we were able to catch them early on
provide a comprehensive view of animal health and disease
we're at some of the largest livestock and pharmaceutical companies in the world

notes: Three software pillars kept as facets of one analytics platform value mechanism (v1.5.1 §4.1.7) rather than three premises; demo workflows illustrate those pillars. Precision-husbandry vision treated as future framing, not a premise (§4.1.4). Citizen-science ask excluded as closing ask. Singleton D1/D3 retained.
